title: Chestnut Season
eyebrow: late autumn in the mountains · hills to table
hook: from the hills to the table

places.grove: a steep green mountain slope above a small farmhouse in southwest China in late autumn: old chestnut trees with yellowing leaves, a narrow earth path with stone steps, fallen spiky green-and-brown chestnut burrs and brown leaves on the ground, ferns, mist in the valley below and layered green hills beyond
places.courtyard: the stone-paved courtyard of a small old farmhouse in the mountains of southwest China: grey brick and pale mud walls, a dark wooden door, grey tile eaves, a low wooden bench, bamboo racks, a stone step, a big round flat bamboo sieve tray resting on two low wooden trestles, potted chilli plants, and beyond a low wall green hills with mist
places.kitchen: her small old farmhouse kitchen: a whitewashed brick wood-fired stove with one wide black iron wok set into it and a small fire door below with stacked split firewood, a dark wooden lid hanging on the wall, a worn wooden worktop, a small wooden window with a view of green hills, a clay water jar with a gourd ladle, smoke-darkened roof beams, a few bamboo baskets on the wall
places.stream: a small clear mountain stream right behind the farmhouse: smooth grey stones, cold clear running water, ferns and bamboo along the banks, a flat stone slab at the edge for washing
places.eaves: the covered porch under the grey tile eaves of the farmhouse facing the valley: an old square wooden table with two long benches, a woven bamboo mat on the floor, a pot of tea, and beyond the edge of the eaves green hills falling into a misty valley

light.morning: Early morning, soft cool daylight, mist lying in the valley and drifting between the hills.
light.late morning: Late morning, bright soft daylight, thin clouds, the mist lifting.
light.afternoon: Afternoon, soft clear daylight through thin clouds.
light.late afternoon: Late afternoon, soft low daylight, long gentle shadows, never orange.
light.dusk: Dusk, soft blue fading daylight over the hills and one plain warm bulb on under the eaves; everything clearly visible.

outfits.hills: a loose indigo hand-dyed cotton jacket with cloth knot buttons over an off-white cotton shirt, wide dark-grey linen trousers, black cloth shoes, a woven bamboo back basket on her back
outfits.work: a loose indigo hand-dyed cotton jacket with the sleeves rolled to the forearm over an off-white cotton shirt, wide dark-grey linen trousers, black cloth shoes
outfits.kitchen: an off-white cotton shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm, a plain dark-brown cotton apron, wide dark-grey linen trousers
outfits.dusk: an off-white cotton shirt, a soft grey hand-knitted shawl over her shoulders, wide dark-grey linen trousers

grove.brief: The chestnut grove empty, nobody in it, seen from the path: old chestnut trees with yellowing leaves, burrs on the ground, the misty valley below.

courtyard.brief: The courtyard empty, nobody in it, seen from the doorway corner: the stone paving, the big round bamboo sieve tray on its trestles, the bench, the eaves, green hills beyond the low wall.

kitchen.brief: The kitchen empty, nobody in it, seen from the doorway: the whitewashed brick stove with its black iron wok, the firewood, the worktop, the small window onto green hills.

eaves.brief: The porch under the eaves empty, nobody in it: the square wooden table with two benches, a teapot, the misty valley beyond.

Doudou.brief: Close photograph of Doudou alone, a small young country dog with a short cream-and-light-tan coat, a white chest, soft folded-over ear tips, dark eyes and a curled tail, lying on grey stone paving in a farmhouse courtyard, soft daylight.

back basket.brief: A tall woven bamboo back basket with two cloth-wrapped straps standing on stone steps, half full of brown chestnuts, nobody in the frame.

clay pot.brief: A small round brown glazed clay rice pot with a clay lid and a short side handle, standing on a little red-clay charcoal stove on stone, nobody in the frame.

beats.shot: Wide shot of layered green mountains at dawn, mist lying in the valley, the grey tile roof of a small farmhouse among bamboo far below, chestnut trees on the slope in the foreground.
beats.move: Only the mist moves, drifting slowly along the valley; the trees, the slope and the farmhouse stay still. No one walks into the frame.

beats.shot: Wide shot of the farmhouse courtyard at dawn, the dark wooden door closed, dew on the stone paving, Doudou asleep curled on the stone step.
beats.move: Doudou breathes slowly and lifts one ear.

beats.shot: Medium shot from behind: she stands at the open wooden door, lifting the woven bamboo back basket onto her back, the courtyard and the misty hills in front of her.
beats.move: She settles the straps on her shoulders and steps out over the threshold.

beats.shot: Wide shot of the narrow earth path with stone steps climbing the slope between chestnut trees; she walks up it away from the camera, small in the frame, Doudou trotting ahead.
beats.move: She climbs slowly step by step; the dog stops and waits for her.

beats.shot: Close-up of the ground under a chestnut tree: brown fallen leaves and several spiky green-and-brown chestnut burrs split open, shiny brown chestnuts showing inside, dew on everything.
beats.move: One yellow leaf falls slowly and settles among the burrs.

beats.shot: Close-up of her black cloth shoe pressing gently on a split spiky chestnut burr on the leaves so it opens wider, showing two shiny brown chestnuts.
beats.move: The burr opens under her shoe; the chestnuts roll a little.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hands holding long bamboo tongs, picking a shiny brown chestnut out of a split spiky burr on the ground; her indigo sleeves at the edge of the frame.
beats.move: She lifts the chestnut out with the tongs, slowly and carefully.

beats.shot: Medium shot from the side: she bends under a chestnut tree on the slope and drops chestnuts from her bamboo tongs over her shoulder into the bamboo back basket.
beats.move: She tips the tongs toward the basket; chestnuts drop in.

beats.shot: Wide shot of the slope under the old chestnut trees, mist in the valley below, no one there; brown burrs scattered on the leaves.
Medium shot from behind: she holds a long bamboo pole up into the branches of a chestnut tree and taps a branch.
beats.move: She taps the branch twice; a few spiky burrs drop onto the leaves around her.

beats.shot: Close-up: Doudou sniffs at a spiky chestnut burr on the leaves, then backs away from it, ears up.
beats.move: The dog sniffs, flinches back and looks at the burr.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up into the woven bamboo back basket resting on the ground, half full of brown chestnuts of different sizes with a few leaves among them.
beats.move: Her hand drops one more handful of chestnuts in; they settle.

beats.shot: Medium shot from the side: she sits on a stone step on the slope with the back basket beside her, drinking water from a small bamboo tube, looking out over the valley.
beats.move: She drinks slowly and lowers the bamboo tube; strands of hair move in the wind.

beats.shot: Wide shot of the valley and layered green hills from the slope, mist lifting, a few chestnut leaves at the top of the frame.
Wide shot of the stone steps going down through the trees toward the farmhouse roof; she walks down away from the camera with the full basket on her back, Doudou behind her.
beats.move: She walks down slowly, one step at a time.

beats.shot: Wide shot of the courtyard in soft daylight: the big round flat bamboo sieve tray on its trestles in the middle, the woven back basket set down beside it, the hills beyond the wall.
beats.move: Chilli leaves move in the breeze.

beats.shot: Medium shot: she crouches on the flat stone at the edge of the clear stream, washing brown chestnuts in a shallow round bamboo basket in the running water.
beats.move: She dips and shakes the basket slowly in the water; water runs out through the weave.

beats.shot: Close-up of a shallow round bamboo basket of brown chestnuts held in cold clear running water, a few leaves and bits of burr floating away downstream; her hands at the rim.
beats.move: Water runs through the chestnuts; a leaf floats away.

beats.shot: Close-up of clear water running over smooth grey stones in the stream, ferns at the edge.
Medium shot from the side: she tips the wet chestnuts from the bamboo basket onto the big round flat bamboo sieve tray and spreads them out with her hands.
beats.move: She spreads the chestnuts with flat hands into one layer.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hands sorting chestnuts on the round bamboo tray, putting a small cracked one aside into a little clay bowl.
beats.move: She turns a chestnut over, sets it aside, picks up the next.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of the round bamboo sieve tray covered in one layer of drying brown chestnuts in soft sun, the shadow of a leaf moving across them.
Close-up: Doudou lies on the warm stone paving in the sun beside the trestle, eyes half closed.
beats.move: The dog breathes slowly; its ear twitches once.

beats.shot: Medium shot from behind: she sits on the low wooden bench in the courtyard sorting chestnuts on her lap in a small bamboo basket, the hills in front of her.
beats.move: She turns the chestnuts slowly; her braid moves a little in the breeze.

beats.shot: Wide shot of the farmhouse from the courtyard gate: grey tiles, pale walls, the bamboo tray of chestnuts in the sun, bamboo moving behind the roof.
Close-up of her hands pouring dried chestnuts from the round bamboo tray into a woven bamboo basket.
beats.move: The chestnuts slide off the tray into the basket.

beats.shot: Medium shot from the side: she carries the basket of chestnuts on her hip across the courtyard toward the dark wooden kitchen door, Doudou getting up to follow.
beats.move: She walks slowly to the door; the dog stands and follows.

beats.shot: Wide shot of the farmhouse kitchen in soft daylight from the window: the whitewashed brick stove with its wide black iron wok, firewood stacked below, smoke-darkened beams.
beats.move: A thin line of smoke rises from the fire door.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hands feeding a split piece of firewood into the small fire door of the brick stove, small flames inside.
beats.move: She pushes the wood in slowly; the flames catch it.

beats.shot: Close-up of the fire inside the stove's fire door: flames licking split firewood.
beats.move: The flames move and the wood crackles.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of the wide black iron wok with a layer of coarse dark sand heating in it.
beats.move: Her long iron spatula enters the frame and turns the sand slowly.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up: her hand tips a bowl of brown chestnuts, each one already scored with a small slit, into the hot dark sand in the black iron wok.
beats.move: The chestnuts tumble into the sand.

beats.shot: Medium shot from the side: she stands at the brick stove stirring the wok of sand and chestnuts with a long iron spatula, steady and slow, soft window light on her.
beats.move: She stirs with long slow strokes.

beats.shot: Close-up of brown chestnuts tumbling in hot dark sand in the black iron wok as the spatula turns them; the slits beginning to open.
beats.move: The spatula turns the sand and chestnuts slowly.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hand drizzling dark amber syrup from a small clay jug over the chestnuts in the wok.
beats.move: A thin line of syrup falls onto the chestnuts; they keep turning.

beats.shot: Close-up of glossy roasted chestnuts in dark sand in the wok, their split shells curled open showing golden chestnut inside, a little smoke.
beats.move: A thin wisp of smoke rises from the wok.

beats.shot: Close-up: Doudou sits in the kitchen doorway, nose lifted, sniffing the air.
beats.move: The dog sniffs, licks its nose and tilts its head.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up: her hands shake a wide-mesh bamboo sieve full of roasted chestnuts over the wok so the sand falls back through.
beats.move: The sand pours through the sieve; the glossy chestnuts stay.

beats.shot: Close-up of a heap of glossy sugar-roasted chestnuts on brown paper on the wooden worktop, shells split open, steam rising.
beats.move: Steam rises slowly from the chestnuts.

beats.shot: Close-up of her two hands pressing a roasted chestnut at its slit so the shell cracks open and she lifts out the whole golden chestnut.
beats.move: She squeezes, the shell opens, the golden chestnut comes out whole.

beats.shot: Medium shot from the side: she stands by the small kitchen window eating one roasted chestnut, the green hills outside.
beats.move: She chews slowly and looks out of the window.

beats.shot: Close-up: Doudou sits looking up beside her dark trouser legs; her hand lowers a small piece of chestnut to the dog.
beats.move: The dog takes the piece gently and its tail wags.

beats.shot: Wide shot of the hills beyond the courtyard wall, clouds moving slowly over the ridges, smoke from the kitchen chimney drifting across.
Top-down close-up of her hands shelling boiled chestnuts over a wide clay bowl, the soft pale-yellow chestnuts dropping in.
beats.move: She squeezes a chestnut out of its shell into the bowl.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of a wide clay bowl full of whole peeled pale-yellow chestnuts on the wooden worktop.
Close-up of her hands washing white rice in a wooden basin at the edge of the stream, the water turning milky.
beats.move: Her fingers stir the rice slowly; milky water swirls.

beats.shot: Close-up of a small red-clay charcoal stove on the courtyard stones with red-hot charcoal, a round brown clay rice pot sitting on it.
beats.move: The charcoal pulses softly; a thin heat haze rises.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up into the round brown clay pot: white rice in water, her hand placing whole peeled chestnuts on top of the rice one by one.
beats.move: She sets the chestnuts down gently on the rice.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hand setting the clay lid on the round brown clay rice pot.
beats.move: The lid settles; a thin line of steam starts at its edge.

beats.shot: Medium shot from the side: she sits at the worktop pounding boiled chestnuts in a grey stone mortar with a wooden pestle.
beats.move: She lifts and lowers the pestle slowly and steadily.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of a grey stone mortar of smooth mashed pale-yellow chestnut, a wooden pestle resting in it, her hand sprinkling a little sugar in.
beats.move: The sugar falls onto the mash.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hands pressing pale-yellow chestnut paste into a small carved wooden flower mould on the worktop.
beats.move: She presses the paste in with her thumbs and smooths the top.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hands tapping the carved wooden mould on a plate so a small flower-shaped pale-yellow chestnut cake drops out.
beats.move: She taps the mould; the little cake drops out whole.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of six small flower-shaped pale-yellow chestnut cakes on a plain white plate, a few dried yellow osmanthus flowers sprinkled over them.
beats.move: Her hand sprinkles a pinch of osmanthus; the flowers settle.

beats.shot: Close-up of the round brown clay pot on the charcoal stove, steam puffing gently from under the lid.
beats.move: Steam puffs and curls up from the lid.

beats.shot: Medium shot from behind: she sits on a low stool beside the charcoal stove fanning it with a round palm-leaf fan, Doudou lying next to her.
beats.move: She fans slowly; the dog rests its chin on its paws.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up: her hand lifts the clay lid off the round pot: rice cooked through with whole golden chestnuts on top, a cloud of steam.
beats.move: Steam rises in a soft cloud as the lid comes away.

beats.shot: Close-up of a pair of wooden chopsticks turning the chestnut rice in the clay pot, a golden crust at the edge.
beats.move: The chopsticks lift a little rice with crust; steam rises.

beats.shot: Wide shot of the courtyard in late afternoon, the clay pot steaming on its stove, the bamboo tray empty, the hills going soft behind.
Wide shot of the valley at dusk from the porch, layered blue hills, mist settling, the edge of the tile eaves at the top of the frame.
Medium shot from the side: she sets the round clay pot of chestnut rice down on the old square wooden table under the eaves, a plain warm bulb on above.
beats.move: She sets the pot down gently and straightens.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of the wooden table: the clay pot of chestnut rice, a plain white plate of six small soft pale-yellow chestnut cakes pressed in a flower shape (smooth, unbaked, not browned), a little heap of roasted chestnuts on brown paper, a pot of tea and one bowl with chopsticks.
beats.move: Steam rises slowly from the rice and the tea.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hand pouring tea from a brown clay teapot into a small cup on the wooden table.
beats.move: The tea pours in a thin stream; steam rises.

beats.shot: Medium shot from the side: she sits on the bench at the wooden table, the shawl over her shoulders, holding a bowl of chestnut rice and eating with chopsticks, the blue valley behind.
beats.move: She takes a small bite and chews slowly.

beats.shot: Close-up of her chopsticks lifting a soft golden chestnut from the bowl of rice.
beats.move: She lifts it slowly; a little steam.

beats.shot: Close-up: Doudou sits by the bench looking up at the table, tail curled, ears soft.
beats.move: The dog's tail sweeps once over the floor.

beats.shot: Close-up of her fingers taking one small soft pale-yellow flower-shaped chestnut cake (smooth, unbaked, not browned) from a plain white plate of them.
beats.move: She lifts the cake off the plate.

beats.shot: Medium shot from behind: she sits at the table with her cup of tea, looking out at the dark-blue hills, Doudou lying at her feet.
beats.move: She lifts the cup and drinks slowly; the dog breathes.

beats.shot: Close-up of the empty bowl and chopsticks resting across it on the table, a few chestnut shells on the brown paper, the teacup.
Wide shot of the farmhouse from the courtyard at dusk, one warm bulb lit under the eaves, the blue hills behind and the first stars.
Wide shot of the dark chestnut slope above the farmhouse at dusk, one small lit window below among the bamboo, mist in the valley.

short.text: from the hills to the table
